note: Only these characters may appear. Each was checked against scripture and iconography and approved by the owner. Add a new one only after the owner approves its stills.

about.shiva: blue-grey ash skin, matted hair with crescent moon, Vasuki at neck (or shoulder only for the blue-throat story), trishul, tiger skin; blesses with his RIGHT hand; seated on Kailash or standing
about.parvati: fair, red sari with gold border, sindoor, bindi, two arms; blesses with right hand
about.boy: the boy Parvati created (Ganesha before the elephant head), yellow dhoti, staff
about.ganesha: child form, red complexion (Shiva Purana), elephant head, trunk curls to HIS LEFT, left tusk whole, right tusk broken, modak in left hand, right hand abhaya, gold crown
